title: Add the factor_rule_v1 strategy kind with one evaluator for backtest and paper

acceptance_criteria_verification.schema_and_momentum_checksums: strategy_artifact.schema.json accepts close_to_close_momentum and factor_rule_v1 via oneOf; test_existing_builtin_and_persona_artifact_checksums_unchanged verifies byte-identical SHA-256 checksums for all built-in and persona momentum artifacts.
acceptance_criteria_verification.operator_grammar_coverage: services/registry/factor_rule.py implements all 22 operators from Design section 9.2 and all 14 time-series operators from Dev Plan section 3.4 (36 time-series operators total), parses cross-sectional operators (cs_rank, cs_scale, industry_neutralize) when allow_cross_sectional=True, and rejects unknown and cross-sectional operators in per-symbol factor_rule_v1 validation and evaluation.
acceptance_criteria_verification.point_in_time_input_visibility: resolve_point_in_time_inputs enforces available_time <= decision_time and event_time + timedelta(days=availability_lag_days) <= decision_time; test_point_in_time_inputs_hide_future_observations and test_availability_lag_days_enforced_even_when_available_time_is_earlier prove future observations are invisible.
acceptance_criteria_verification.paper_producer_feature_map_and_allowlist: paper_signal_producer.py passes features and decision_time into evaluate_strategy_view and evaluate_strategy_action and accepts both close_to_close_momentum and factor_rule_v1 in CurrentArtifactStrategy.
acceptance_criteria_verification.backtest_paper_parity: TestFactorRuleBacktestAndPaperParity.test_factor_rule_v1_vectorbt_backtest_and_paper_replay_produce_identical_actions proves identical 32-bar action sequences and signed order sizes between vectorbt_adapter and CurrentArtifactStrategy paper replay.
acceptance_criteria_verification.mutable_controls_and_immutable_structure: validate_factor_rule_logic rejects bare numeric literals and requires every const_param to be declared in mutation_surface.controls with allowed_range and step while strategy_logic remains immutable under mutate_strategy_artifact.
